name: SikaWrap-600 C WV
paste:
SIKAWRAP®-600 C WV: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaWrap®-600 C WV, March 2026, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikawrap-600-c-wv.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaWrap®-600 C WV where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaWrap®-600 C WV is an unidirectional woven carbon fibre fabric. It is part of the SikaWrap® composite strengthening system. The Product is made of high-strength carbon fibres with an area density of 600 g/m 2. The fabric is designed for installation using the wet application process.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaWrap®-600 C WV may only be used by experienced professionals. SikaWrap®-600 C WV is used as a reinforcement fabric for externally bonded structural strengthening systems on concrete, masonry and wooden substrates. Externally bonded structural strengthening systems are used for:
    - Increasing the flexural and shear loading capacity of elements and structures
    - Enhancing the load-carrying capacity or ductility of structural members in compression
    - Replacing missing steel reinforcement
    - Structural upgrading of weak concrete elements or structures
    - Improving impact resistance
    - Passive strengthening for seismic event protection
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - A specialist structural engineer must be consulted for any structural strengthening design calculation.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaWrap®-600 C WV
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Woven, unidirectional, high-strength carbon fibre fabric with a fibre area density of 600 g/m², designed for structural strengthening applications
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Australia: AS5100.8:2017 Bridge Design, Part 8 Rehabilitation and Strengthening of existing bridges, CFS(1) Carbon Fabric
    - Australia: Vic Roads Spec Section 688 - Fibre Reinforced Polymer Composite Strengthening of Concrete Structures
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS5100.8:2017: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - EN 2561: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate tensile strength (p.2).
    - ASTM D3039: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate tensile strength (p.2).
    - ISO 10618: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Dry fibre tensile strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very cost effective in comparison to traditional strengthening techniques
    - Fast application increases productivity, saves time and reduces disruption
    - Enables upgrading of a structure to comply with current standards
    - Improves the service life of a structure
    - Manufactured with thermo-welded weft fibres to keep the fabric stable
    - Multifunctional fabric for use in many different strengthening applications
    - Flexible and accommodating to different surface planes and geometry (such as beams, columns, chimneys, piles, walls, soffits and silos)
    - Low density for minimal additional weight
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Dry fibre density: 1.805 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fibre type: Selected high strength carbon fibres
    - Mass per area: (600 ± 30) g/m²
    - Design nominal thickness: 1 mm
    - Design nominal cross section: 332 mm² per metre width
    - Dry fibre elongation at break: 2.1 %
    - Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension: 230 kN/mm² (ISO 10618)
    - Dry fibre tensile strength: 4900 N/mm² (ISO 10618)
2.7 Construction.
    | Fibre orientation | 0° (longitudinal, unidirectional) |
    | Warp (longitudinal) | Black carbon fibre, 95 % |
    | Weft (transversal) | E-Glass 5% |
2.8 Laminate tensile strength.
    | Mean | 3975 N/mm² |
    | 5 % characteristic | 3600 N/mm² |
    | Mean | 1360 N/mm² |
    | Characteristic (ACI 440.2R) | 1230 N/mm² |
    | All values refer to the relevant design nominal thickness. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
    Test method printed: (ASTM D3039)
2.9 Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension.
    | Mean | 225 kN/mm² |
    | 5 % characteristic | 215 kN/mm² |
    | Mean | 73 kN/mm² |
    | All values refer to the relevant design nominal thickness. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
    Test method printed: (ASTM D3039)
2.10 Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean. 1.7 %
    | 5 % characteristic | 1.6 % |
    | Mean | 1.8 % |
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
    Test method printed: (ASTM D3039)
2.11 System structure. The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed.
    | Concrete substrate adhesive primer | Sikadur®-330 or Sikadur®-300 or |
    | Sikadur® Hex-300 |
    | Impregnating or laminating resin | Sikadur®-300 or Sikadur® Hex-300 |
    | Structural strengthening fabric | SikaWrap®-600 C WV |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 3) for the layout.)
    For detailed information on Sikadur®-330, Sikadur®-300, or Sikadur® Hex- 300, together with the resin and fabric application details, please refer to the individual Product Data Sheets and the relevant Method Statement.
2.12 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
2.13 Packaging.
    | Roll width | 500 mm |
    | Roll length | 50 m |
    | Refer to the current price list for available packaging variations. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.14 Storage conditions. The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Protect the Product from direct sunlight. Always refer to the packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 02.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Tensile adhesion strength of the substrate must be a minimum of 1.0 N/mm² or as specified in the strengthening design. If necessary, verify this by applying a test area first.
    - Refer to the relevant SikaWrap® Method Statement for further information.
3.3 Substrate preparation.
    - Clean and prepare concrete to achieve a laitance-free, contaminant-free, open-textured surface.
    - Refer to the relevant SikaWrap® Method Statement for further information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2026, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Dry fibre thickness: 0.332 mm
4.3 Consumption. WET APPLICATION WITH
    | Primer and first layer | Sikadur®-300 or | 0.8–1.2 kg/m² |
    | Sikadur® Hex-300 |
    | Following layers | Sikadur®-300 or | 0.85–1.0 kg/m² |
    | Sikadur® Hex-300 |
    | WET APPLICATION WITH |
    | Concrete substrate ad- | Sikadur®-330 | 0.4–0.6 kg/m² |
    | hesive primer |
    | Impregnating or lamin- | Sikadur®-300 or | 0.85–1.0 kg/m² |
    | ating resin | Sikadur® Hex-300 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Important.
    - Application by trained personnel
    - The application of this Product must only be carried out by an applicator that is trained or approved by Sika. The applicator must also be experienced in this type of application.
4.5 Important.
    - Strictly follow installation procedures
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in Method Statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
4.6 Important. Do not interchange different system components SikaWrap® fabrics are coated to ensure maximum bond and durability with the Sikadur® adhesives, impregnating and laminating resins. To maintain and ensure full system compatibility, do not interchange different system components. 1. IMPORTANT Never fold the fabric. Cut the fabric with special scissors, a razor knife or a box-cutter knife. 2. Apply the SikaWrap fabric using the wet application process. Refer to 850 41 03 Method Statement SikaWrap® manual wet application.
4.7 Overcoating sikawrap® fabrics. SikaWrap® fabrics can be overcoated with a cementitious overlay or other coatings for aesthetic or protective purposes. The selection of the overcoating system depends on the exposure and project-specific requirements. For additional protection from UV light in exposed areas, use one of the following:
    - Sikagard®-550 W Elastic
    - Sikagard®-675 W ElastoColor
    - Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor
    - Sikagard®-5500
4.8 Further documentation. Reference must be made to the following Sika® Method Statements:
    - 850 41 03 Method Statement SikaWrap® manual wet application

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2026, Version 02.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile adhesion strength of the substrate must be a minimum of 1.0 N/mm² or as specified in the strengthening design. If necessary, verify this by applying a test area first.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Laminate tensile strength: Mean | 3975 N/mm²; 5 % characteristic | 3600 N/mm²; Mean | 1360 N/mm²; Characteristic (ACI 440.2R) | 1230 N/mm²; All values refer to the relevant design nominal thickness. (EN 2561) (ASTM D3039)
    - Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension: Mean | 225 kN/mm²; 5 % characteristic | 215 kN/mm²; Mean | 73 kN/mm²; All values refer to the relevant design nominal thickness. (EN 2561) (ASTM D3039)
    - Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean: 5 % characteristic | 1.6 %; Mean | 1.8 %; 1.7 % (EN 2561) (ASTM D3039)
    - Dry fibre modulus of elasticity in tension: 230 kN/mm² (ISO 10618)
    - Dry fibre tensile strength: 4900 N/mm² (ISO 10618)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaWrap®-600 C WV, March 2026, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikawrap-600-c-wv.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaWrap®-600 C WV, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sds-sikawrap-600cwv.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
